ground_truth: Hand-written by the author. SQL cases are graded against a gold query run on the frozen ops_eval database at eval time; policy cases against the sections the author identified in data/policies; refusals and proposals against the status the loop records.

cases.question: How many completed orders did we have in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1 AND state = 'completed' AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: What were our gross sales in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT sum(gross_sales_cents) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1 AND state = 'completed' AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: What was the average tip on orders that had a tip in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT avg(tip_cents) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1 AND state = 'completed' AND tip_cents IS NOT NULL AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: How many orders came through Grubhub in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1 AND channel = 'grubhub' AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: How many orders were canceled in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1 AND state = 'canceled' AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: What share of our completed orders in September 2026 were delivery?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE fulfillment_type = 'delivery') / count(*) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1 AND state = 'completed' AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: How much did we take in cash in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT sum(p.amount_cents) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.merchant_id = 1 AND p.entry_method = 'CASH' AND p.status = 'completed' AND date_trunc('month', o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: How many orders did we complete in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 2 AND state = 'completed' AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: Which day of the week brought in the most gross sales in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT trim(to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver', 'Day')) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 2 AND state = 'completed' AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver') = '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(gross_sales_cents) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What was the average order total for in-store orders in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT avg(total_cents) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1 AND state = 'completed' AND channel = 'in_store' AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: How many different identified customers ordered in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1 AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') = '2026-09-01'

cases.question: How many of our customers have verified SMS consent and have not unsubscribed?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE merchant_id = 2 AND sms_opt_in AND unsubscribed_at IS NULL
